app_minimized.description: Start the application window minimized to the system tray. Corresponds to the -m / --minimized flag.

rpc_host.description: The hostname or IP address where the Transmission daemon is listening for RPC connections.

rpc_port.description: The TCP port number where the Transmission daemon is listening for RPC connections.

rpc_username.description: Username required for authenticating with the Transmission daemon RPC interface.

rpc_password.description: Password required for authenticating with the Transmission daemon RPC interface.

startup_torrent.description: A path to a .torrent file, a magnet link, or a URL to be added to Transmission upon application startup.
